Test infrastructure: builds, silent refusals, faster suites. build_claude.sh <config> [worktree] builds an agent's own folder through ccache (one cache for every worktree), copies a fresh worktree's submodules and waits for the machine's build lock (any other ninja counts too; build_web and the Ubuntu 22.04 build take it as well). scenario_slot_reuse.sh (in regression.sh): real games on a 1-slot server - every way of leaving frees the slot in time, the same key rejoins at once, UDP and WebRTC in turns, the master restarted, a newcomer after a whole ranked match. The tournament suite polls instead of sleeping (~33 min on two shards instead of ~90 alone), reads round deadlines from the live page, merges duplicated cases, splits cases by SHARDS, runs a copy of itself, and an empty or unknown case list fails. lib.sh: shared waits and a cleanup that leaves nothing running (no orphaned Xvfb). regression.sh: unit tests, outage, WebRTC ranked and a crowd, the handshake limit, stronger keys/password checks.
